title: Fractions — equivalent parts of one whole
subject: math
disclaimer: Equal-width pieces represent one whole; this diagram illustrates fraction size, not real-world object scale.

beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict what fraction will be shaded when you change the number of equal pieces.

beats.label: Compare
beats.narration: Compare 3 out of 4 with 6 out of 8; the same proportion of one whole is shaded.

beats.label: Explain
beats.narration: Numerator counts shaded parts; denominator counts equal parts in the whole.

check.question: Which is equal to 3/4?
check.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by the same non-zero value: 3/4 = 6/8.
